reviewer.note: docs/reviews/2026-11-08-undercroft-woodland-placed.md (main's bytes acf4e5ea). Compared at x1.37 with Eastward's yard bench (shot 17, box 410,15,472,55): ours 18.6 tones and 30.7 shapes a patch against that bench's 17.9 and 33.6, and it matches the kit/bench anchor. detail.bar 0.61 accepted as polish: the band mean is raised by the lamp, the pot and the bench2 box with two people seated on it. Open polish: B-1, bolt heads are 1x2 dark slots with no lit pixel above (wood recipe); B-2, the 3 to 4 rows under the seat are one flat tone across 90 px.
